text: By design the Odds API keys are used one at a time, in your order: the first key that can still afford the call. I couldn't open your screenshot (it isn't on the chat-files branch), so this is from the engine's usage.json. Right now 9 of your 14 keys are spent (0-1 credits left) or marked 'monthly credits used up', so the pool has walked past them. Keys 10-14 each show only about 15 calls and 45-60 credits, spread over the last 10-20 hours, which looks like one key picked per engine job rather than a spread. I haven't confirmed the cause or changed any code. If the screenshot shows something else, like the app's meters showing several keys active at once, tell me which screen. I'll check the key order per job next.
